lessons.story:
SATURDAY REPAIR DESK: Bring your schoolbag to the community hall this Saturday. Volunteers can fix loose buttons and small holes. They cannot replace whole zippers. The service is free, but each visitor may bring only one bag.

The desk opens at nine and stops accepting bags at eleven. Repairs already accepted may continue until noon. Write your name and phone number on a paper label, and keep the matching number card until you collect your bag.

Visitors under thirteen must come with an adult. No reservation is needed for a repair. However, the short sewing class at ten requires an online booking because there are only six seats beside the worktable.

If your bag cannot be repaired here, a volunteer will explain why before starting. Please empty every pocket at home. We cannot store food, money, or other personal items during the repair.
